move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer provides a price of €18.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We welcome your offer of 14-day payment terms and have factored this into our pricing. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. The change from EXW to DAP includes significant freight costs, which explains the increase from our initial unit price. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We have set the lead time to 35 days to guarantee our quality standards, and we look forward to discussing your full volume needs. Which volume can you commit to?

Alternatively, with a price of €17.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have carefully considered the competing offer you shared and have reduced our price to reflect this market evidence.

Our offer stands at a price of €17.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €17.20 per unit. We welcome the 14-day payment terms, which allow us to provide this more favorable pricing.

We must adjust the lead time to 28 days to guarantee our quality standards, and we kindly ask you to confirm the expected order volume. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
